result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders are now left out of the per-rep purchase-order count, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

The cause was in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its subquery had no status filter, unlike the per-quarter and latest-PO queries. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to it and extended its Javadoc to say so.

In `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java` I added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces your example, plus a status parameter on the test helper. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes offline. I didn't run the full suite, and I didn't confirm that the new test fails without the fix.

Nothing is committed.
